title: feat(service-automation)!: a sync-in pull marks the rows the source deleted (ADR-0153 D3, #32062 slice 6)

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

Part of #32062

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none (no skills/ page names `deletePolicy`, `deletedField` or `_sync_deleted_at`: `git grep -c -E "deletePolicy|deletedField|_sync_deleted_at" -- skills/` exits 1 with zero hits at 0f46c642ca, control `git grep -c "name:" -- skills/` hits; the guide that teaches them is `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx`, updated here)

## 维护者速读
- 同步数据的管理员会看到:源系统删掉的记录,在平台里被打上"源已删除"标记(不会真删),源里恢复后标记自动清除;增量同步若没说明如何识别删除,保存时会被拒。
- 属于"单向同步进平台(sync-in)"这件事的第六步:让同步能如实反映源系统的删除。
- 出错时最坏是某些行被误标或漏标为"已删除",数据本身不丢、不删;下一次完整同步会纠正,改动可整体撤回。
- 无

## What changes

ADR-0153 D3 (delete marking) on both sync-in read paths, plus the carried review nits. Not in this PR (later slices of the card): D4 purge, D6 drift, D8 refusals beyond what landed, the connector paging loop.

- **Delete marking** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/sync-delete-mark.ts`, new sibling module). Under `deletePolicy` absent (reads as `'mark'`) or `'mark'`, a pull stamps `_sync_deleted_at` on a row the source deleted and clears it when a later pull reads the row again; `'ignore'` leaves every row. Two detections:
  - `deletedField`, on any pull that declares it: truthy marks the row's copy, anything else clears it.
  - Absence, on a full pull whose read was complete: every row of this mapping (`_sync_source`) not stamped by this run (`_sync_pulled_at` before the run start) and not refused by it is marked.
- **Completeness, per ADR-0153 D3.** Datasource source: `full: true`, the windows read to their end on either read path, and the NULL-watermark count (D2 invariant 11, under the D8 organization predicate; through the floor on a floored driver, recorded as cap plus one above the cap) is zero, else `unjudged, null watermark`. The mark's range is limited to rows whose copied watermark is non-NULL and at or above `watermark.start`. Connector source: no `watermark` and `paging: { style: 'none' }`; no `paging` records `unjudged, no paging declared`, a paging style whose loop is not built records `unjudged, pages not followed`. A refused or interrupted pull marks nothing by absence; more than 1000 runner-refused rows, or any read row with a blank match key (it names no target row), records `unjudged, rows refused` (review M1). A batch's keys go into each find 500 at a time (`KEYS_PER_FILTER`), far below any dialect's bound-parameter limit, however long a connector response is (review S1).
- **Incremental-`mark` refusal (the narrowing).** `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, new export) refuses at parse (`MappingSchema`, path `[source, 'deletePolicy']`) an incremental source (connector with `watermark`, datasource without `full: true`) under `'mark'` with no `deletedField`; both pulls ask the same rule at run time (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, reason `delete_policy_unhonourable`). Migration entry `incremental-source-delete-policy-stated` (ADR-0087 semantic); changeset carries the marker and the FROM/TO fix.
- **A `synced` target that withholds the provenance columns** (`systemFields: false`) is refused under `'mark'` (`mapping_target_refused`). This is the second BREAKING arm: it is judged only when the pull runs, and `os validate` does not catch it. Migration entry 18 names it, its replacement, and the failed `sys_sync_run` as the signal for a mapping stored at run time; the changeset and `jobs.mdx` say the same (review S3, N8). No parse-time refusal is added for it. A datasource `deletedField` that is not a source field is refused `source_binding_invalid`.
- **`sys_sync_run`**: new `marked_deleted_count`, `deletes`, `skipped_null_watermark`; end-of-pull log line says what was marked and cleared.
- **Liveness**: `deletePolicy` / `deletedField` under both sources flip `planned` to `live` with evidence, `authorWarn` dropped. `paging` stays `planned`.
- **Nits.** Record 6791935060: N1 `JobHandlerContext` declares `trigger` / `runId`, the jobs guide lists them; N2 `originOf` keeps a trigger or job run id only when the run record can hold it; N3 the self-contradicting `jobs.mdx` sentence reworded; N5 `job_run_id` / `trigger` descriptions say when each is empty; N4 is NOT fixed here (see Acceptance notes). Record 7119012685 / 7120208665: N1 the reordered-`upsertKey` consequence stated at `encodeSyncExternalId` and in the marker; N4 the bare-name `_sync_source` scope stated in the marker (see Decision below); N8 the `Object.is` sentence in `refuseHookSyncProvenanceWrite`; N9 the unreadable-target refusal says whether the object is not registered or the metadata read failed (same reason `mapping_target_refused`, no new reason).

- **Review round 2 (L2 7151034259, L1 7151052312).** M1 and S1 above; S2 `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md`'s `ordersPull` example states `deletedField: 'is_deleted'`, so it parses; S3 above; S4 below; L1 M1 the changeset names `'@objectstack/objectql': patch`. Nits: N1 marks and clears are counted per row, so a run that fails part-way closes with the rows it changed; N2 `deletedField` truthiness (text `'false'` / `'0'` marks, a misspelt connector field marks nothing) stated in `jobs.mdx`, the changeset and the marker; N3 the NULL-watermark count reads only `id` (floored and paged fallback); N4 a stored `deletePolicy` outside `'mark'` / `'ignore'` is refused `delete_policy_unhonourable` by both pulls instead of read as `'mark'`; N5 the connectorSource D3 liveness evidence names `pullOnce` (the executor pin's `pullConnectorSource` kept beside it); N6 `sys_sync_run.deletes` says it is also empty for a connector target with no provenance columns; N7 rows pulled before the provenance columns existed are no mapping's and are never marked (changeset, `jobs.mdx`); N8 entry 18's acceptance criteria name the run-time signal; N9 is the report's.

## Decision

Two mappings on one target: decided here. Each mapping marks and clears only rows whose `_sync_source` is its own; a second mapping is not refused. Cross-package same-name residual carried as item 7151120322 on #32062.

This is the behaviour of this tree: `SyncDeleteMarker` scopes every find by `_sync_source` equal to the mapping's name, and no pull refuses a second mapping on a target.

### Read first (by risk)
1. `packages/services/service-automation/src/sync-delete-mark.ts` — `afterBatch` (the keyless-row count and the 500-key chunks) and `canMarkAbsent` decide whether absence is judged; `markAbsent` (the where clause: `_sync_source`, `_sync_pulled_at` before `runStartedAt`, the refused-key `$nin`, the range) decides which rows are marked.
2. `packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-pull.ts` — the delete judgment after `readSourceInWindows` and `countNullWatermarks`.
3. `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts` — `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` and its use in the sourced-mapping refinement (the narrowing).

### Two-minute check
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sync-delete-mark.test.ts src/datasource-pull.test.ts src/connector-pull.test.ts` — expect 135 passing, among them the four `[review M1]` cases.

## Tests

- `connector-pull.test.ts`: D3 block on a real engine (complete full pull marks then clears; no `paging` and an unfollowed style mark nothing by absence; `deletedField` marks and clears; incremental under mark refused before the action; ignore); `systemFields: false` under ignore vs mark; N2 origin bounds; N9 read-failure refusal.
- `datasource-pull.test.ts`: D3 block (complete full pull marks then clears; floored path, with a NULL count over the cap recorded as cap plus one; range below a raised start untouched; NULL watermark blocks the mark and is counted; the count carries the organization predicate; refused row not marked; another mapping's rows untouched; refused part-way marks nothing; ignore; `deletedField`; the three refusals).
- Round 2: `[review M1]` on both pulls (datasource: one blank-key row plus a deleted row leaves `unjudged, rows refused`, nothing marked, run record says so; connector: a response whose records all lost the key, and one keyless record beside a dropped one); `[review N4]` on both pulls; new `sync-delete-mark.test.ts` (the 1000-key limit at 1000 and 1001, one keyless row makes the run unjudgeable, `$in` chunks of 500/500/1 on clear and 500/1 on mark, a mark failing at row 3 keeps `marked` at 2).
- `mapping-sync-in.test.ts`, `mapping-connector-source.test.ts`: the parse refusal and its legal twins; the liveness pin now expects only `paging` planned.

<details><summary>Local runs (round 2, head 0f46c642ca)</summary>

Each through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict line quoted. Head 0f46c642ca = 357423a92b plus one liveness-evidence text edit (N5).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test && ... typecheck` at 357423a92b: `Test Files 295 passed (295)`, `Tests 4316 passed (4316)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The three touched suites again at 0f46c642ca's code: `Tests 135 passed (135)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test && ... typecheck` at 0f46c642ca: `Test Files 890 passed (890)`, `Tests 28308 passed | 1 todo (28309)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. (At 357423a92b the connectorSource liveness pin was red on the first N5 spelling, which dropped `pullConnectorSource`; fixed in 0f46c642ca.)
- Ablation (one, the M1 fix): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --anchor 'return this.unnamed === 0 && this.unwritten.size' --replacement 'return this.unwritten.size'` (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 5707ffa9842a -> a7b315ca2f01); `vitest run src/sync-delete-mark.test.ts src/datasource-pull.test.ts src/connector-pull.test.ts`: `Tests 4 failed | 131 passed (135)`, the four failures being exactly the three `[review M1]` pull pins and the unit pin "one read row with no key makes the run unjudgeable", `VERDICT command-exit 1`; restored, blob == HEAD 5707ffa9842a, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suites import the module from `src/` by relative path, so no dist leg applies.
- Dogfood battery (title carries `!`) at 0f46c642ca, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' ... build` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`: `Test Files 487 passed | 3 skipped (490)`, `Tests 4128 passed | 68 skipped (4196)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **N4 of record 6791935060 (cli CHANGELOG "see its own entry") is not fixed here.** The sentence is in released entries (`packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md:1203`, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3173`; the same phrase in four more packages' released entries). CHANGELOGs are release-owned: a released-entry correction is a dedicated docs-only PR, never a rider on a code PR. Carrier: the seat.
- **Edge stated, not fixed:** on the first run after `upsertKey` is reordered, a runner-refused row keeps its old `_sync_external_id` spelling, so the refused-key exclusion (new spelling) does not cover it and the absence mark stamps it; the next run that writes it clears it. Stated in `sync-delete-mark.ts`.
- `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` and `syncDeletePolicyRefusal` judge a stored block at run time, a mapping no parse saw, with the parse's rule; a second door for the same rule, not a lenient alias (a `deletePolicy` outside the enum is now refused, review N4).
- The refused-key `$nin` of `markAbsent` holds at most 1000 keys, unchanged this round (the L2 accepted the bound).
- Files outside the order's surface: `packages/objectql/src/sync-provenance-write.ts` (comment only, N8), `packages/runtime/src/job-handler-context.ts` (N1), `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column*.ts` (describe text of `_sync_deleted_at`), the spec migration entry and generated `api-surface` / `export-origins` / liveness counts; round 2 adds `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` (review S2). The zone amended the claim for them.

## Verification

- First pass at 357423a92b: 121 exit 0; `cli vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` exit 1 (`MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@objectstack/mcp/dist`, the cli closure not built yet), `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (client dist not built). After the closure build, all three re-run at 0f46c642ca: exit 0. `spec check:liveness`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:generated` and `check-nul-bytes` re-run at 0f46c642ca: exit 0.
